findings.evidence: `Subcomodule/Finite.lean:244` defines `exists_finite_subcomodule_of_fg_of_exists_mem` under exactly the weaker elementwise-containment hypothesis, while `:280` derives its `[Module.Free R C]` specialization; the new proof calls only the latter at `Multiplication.lean:178`.
findings.fix: First prove `exists_finite_mul_le_of_exists_mem (hH : ∀ h : H, ∃ Q, Module.Finite R Q.toSubmodule ∧ h ∈ Q) ...`, using `exists_finite_subcomodule_of_fg_of_exists_mem hH`, then derive the current free specialization from `exists_finite_subcomodule_mem`.
findings.issue: `exists_finite_mul_le` assumes `[Module.Free R H]`, but the proof only needs that every element of `H` lies in a finite subcomodule; this omits the natural general theorem used throughout the neighboring finite-subcomodule API.

summary: The finite-product containment theorem is specialized to a free coefficient coalgebra even though the surrounding API provides the natural hypothesis-parametric form.
